# NakeKnight™

> NakeKnight is a creator-led, LGBTQIA+-positive superhero for the weekday grind. He helps turn everyday conflict into practical next steps through nonviolent communication. In the story, he crosses timelines through speculative proton energy; his attire adapts to the era while his face remains consistent.

## Pages

- [Command](/command): Project operations and current development information.
- [Store](/store): Digital products and creator releases; availability and pricing are shown only when verified.

- [License](/license): Merchandise, publishing, gaming, film & media licensing tiers.
